site.aboutIntro:
I am a Computer Science student developing my career around data analytics, business analysis, and finance. I enjoy working with data to understand problems, identify patterns, and communicate insights that can support better decisions.

Alongside technology and analytics, I have a strong interest in financial markets, companies, business models, valuation, and financial analysis.

projects.title: Online Vehicle Parking Reservation System
projects.description: A Django-based web application for managing parking locations, floors, vehicles, parking capacity, and reservations.
projects.problem: Manage parking availability and reservations reliably.
projects.objective: Support customer and admin workflows for vehicle registration, reservations, and booking status.
projects.methodology: Django application with MySQL persistence, date/time availability, validation, and concurrency handling.
projects.insights: Developed as a database-driven web application. No public results are claimed.

projects.title: Sales Performance Analysis
projects.description: A structured exploration of revenue, customers, and product performance to find the signals behind growth.
projects.problem: What patterns explain changes in sales performance?
projects.objective: Build a decision-ready analytical view of sales activity.
projects.methodology: Clean, segment, compare, visualize, and translate patterns into business questions.

projects.title: Revenue Analytics Project
projects.description: An analytical project focused on revenue, sales, customer, and product data.
projects.problem: What business trends and growth drivers appear in revenue data?
projects.objective: Transform raw business data into actionable insights.
projects.methodology: Use Python, NumPy, Pandas, SQL, Excel, and Power BI for analysis and visualization.

projects.title: Company Analysis Notes
projects.description: A living research notebook for understanding a company through performance, business model, and financial ratios.
projects.problem: How can public financial information become a clear company narrative?
projects.objective: Practice structured financial analysis without presenting investment advice.
projects.dataset: Public company filings or another documented source.
projects.methodology: Review statements, calculate ratios, compare periods, and document assumptions.
projects.insights: Analysis will be documented after the source company is selected.
